title: Dealer Retail Agreements: One Agreement per Dealership Business
content:
**Clause.** A dealership business holds a single dealer retail agreement under the Dealer Retail Agreements program; a dealer group with several rooftops signs one agreement per licensed dealership business, each with its own customer profile and dealer number.

**Limit.** For every Dealer Program tier, the number of dealer agreements not terminated at once for one dealership business is 1. Stated per customer profile, a dealership business holds at most 1 such agreement.

## The clause broken down

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Unit that holds an agreement | One licensed dealership business |
| Agreements not terminated at once, per dealership business | 1 |
| Dealer group with several rooftops | One agreement per licensed dealership business |
| Identity of each agreement | Its own customer profile and its own dealer number |

When a dealership signs the dealer retail agreement and applies for approval, the agreement is opened on the dealership's business profile, is assigned a dealer number, records the state of the dealer license, and starts with a holdback balance and a net participation balance of 0.00.

## Hypothetical illustration

A dealer group (hypothetical) operates three rooftops, each a separately licensed dealership business. Under the clause the group signs three agreements, one per licensed dealership business; each of the three has its own customer profile and its own dealer number, and none of the three businesses holds more than 1 agreement not terminated.
